author: ryt79
title: Forces you to pay
content:
I enjoyed this game until Level 34. I don’t mind difficult levels—in fact, I enjoy figuring them out—but a level should be solvable with the resources the game normally provides.

Level 34 gives you 4 regular parking spaces, and after *many* attempts using different strategies, I could not find a way to complete it without additional spaces. I finally looked online for a solution, only to discover that the published Level 34 walkthrough I found uses 6 parking spaces. Another player even commented on the walkthrough asking whether the level can be solved with the regular 4.

There is a difference between making a level challenging and designing it so that the player appears to need paid/extra resources to progress. If Level 34 actually can be completed with the standard 4 parking spaces and no boosters, please provide or demonstrate that solution. Otherwise, the level needs to be rebalanced.

I would happily continue playing if this is fixed, but I’m not paying for extra parking spaces just to get past a level that may not be solvable as provided.

author: Everything-is-taken1987
title: Could’ve been great
content: I’m not one to typically play games on my phone but this one caught my eye and I thought I’d try it. I like the concept, I like the challenge, it works well without glitches. Very enjoyable for a while. However you get to a point where, literally no matter what you do, the levels are impossible to pass. It’s not a matter of skill or strategy. The only way you can pass is by paying money for assists or by sitting through extremely extensive ads. I just took 20 min to pass a single level because I had to watch 7 ads to get the ability to make any headway. Kinda good though…it gave me the reality check I needed to remember that I’m wasting way too much time here anyway. Time to delete and move on!
